purpose: What was lost, what can no longer be confirmed independently, what exactly the tester changes, and on which facts every fresh admission rests. This is the permanent record; it lives outside the cleanable .cache.

lost_evidence.cause: the disk cleanup of 2026-11-08 23:08 removed the retained Root evidence under /home/jericho/.cache
lost_evidence.what_was_removed: 90 of the 91 directories the tester reads; 31 of the 32 top-level pinned Root documents; 115 of the 116 inline .cache paths, among them the closures of FRW-KIMI-ORDINARY-RECEIVE-HISTORY-REPAIR-20261106-R1, FRW-ROOT-M03, FRW-ROOT-M12, FRW-ROOT-W03, FRW-ROOT-S05, FRW-ROOT-SETTINGS-ORDINARY-SAME-SID-BINDER-20261029 and FRW-ROOT-SOURCE102-A02
lost_evidence.not_recoverable: the bytes of a removed document are not re-derivable and are not found by digest anywhere on the machine. There is no backup, no timeshift, no rsync and no snapshot of that directory.
what_can_no_longer_be_confirmed_independ: the byte-exact Root operational closures of the historical runs, so the facts those closures stated cannot be re-verified from their source
the Root custody proofs of the W03, M03, M12, A02 and S05 partial histories
the Root observation of the settings-restarted ordinary area
lost_evidence.what_is_NOT_lost: the tester's own run records and capture files under /home/jericho/.local/share/friday-telegram-bot-test, the serving home's own state and both profile databases, and the reconstructed source table of the D-12 case
lost_evidence.the_rule: the unavailability of an old document never becomes a PASS, never confirms that an effect was completed, and never grants the right to resend. The historical UNKNOWN rows and the prohibitions on repeats stay as they are.

the_three_kinds_of_change.kind: the removed Root documents are recorded as unavailable, not re-asserted
the_three_kinds_of_change.where: safe_read() refuses a missing .cache path with an explicit reason; read_root_pin_or_unavailable() and the individual owners (W03, M03, M12, A02, S05, the settings-restarted area) return a record whose Root facts are marked unavailable instead of claiming the removed facts
the_three_kinds_of_change.why: the bytes of a removed document cannot be re-derived; re-asserting them would substitute evidence for evidence

the_three_kinds_of_change.kind: the closure's own field checks are bypassed only for the documents that are actually gone
the_three_kinds_of_change.where: closure_facts_unavailable gates the byte and field checks of the closure document, and it is used only where the document is missing
the_three_kinds_of_change.why: a document that exists is still checked byte for byte; the bypass never applies to a present document

the_three_kinds_of_change.kind: the admission pins of the new run ids
the_three_kinds_of_change.where: ORDINARY_INDEPENDENT_SCENARIOS, ORDINARY_INDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY (path, bytes, sha256) and the checked authority_id
the_three_kinds_of_change.why: a new admission and a new run id need a new pin; the tester verifies the document's bytes, its canonical encoding, its schema, its authority id, its scenario digests, its window, its boot id, its history size and its gateway binding on every run

tester_delta.the_relaxation_and_its_reason: the history size check was relaxed from exactly 40 rows to at least 40 rows, because the fresh admission carries 41 re-verified rows after the new runs were added. Every row is still re-read from the tester store and re-verified byte for byte.
tester_delta.no_secret_in_the_snapshot: the snapshot pins only paths, byte counts and digests of the admission documents

the_admission_document.what_it_binds: the CURRENT gateway pid and start_time, verified against /proc/<pid>/stat field 21; the state path; the maximum staleness; the boot id; the exact scenario digests of its run ids; the creation and expiry window; and the re-read, byte-for-byte history rows with their deadline, send_state and unknown flag
the_admission_document.what_it_asserts: new_independent_inputs_only, no_old_task_replay, old_rows_modified false, unknown_effects_resolved false, product_or_B00_acceptance false, new_trial_for_historical_task false
the_admission_document.what_it_does_not_assert: that any historical effect was completed, that any removed Root document still exists, or that any run may be repeated

the_admissions_issued_in_this_segment.result: EVIDENCE_READY, the turn in the Jarvis profile with the answer 'Да, готов.'
EVIDENCE_READY, the archive delivered to Telegram
